title: KAITO — If You Want Heat〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Humhumhumm♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Spread plenty over each slice of bread, sandwich them together and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, MEIKO, Miku.
KAITO called us over and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, he's over there.
KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, hello!
Would you all mind coming over to this table for me?
se_walk_men_004_4

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You said that we needed to come here immediately. Were you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like for you to all eat these!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
Can you guess what these are?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
They're sandwiches, yes...?
It looks like they're filled with jam...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, these are peanut butter and jelly sandwiches! They're apparently very popular over in the US!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Uncle Taiga's told me about these!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're apparently so popular over there that they're usually the first thing you learn to make yourself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can understand why since sandwiches were also the first thing I learned to make while helping MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But why did you decide to make these all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know! You want us to eat all these so that we'll be able to hold our own when we meet everyone over there!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, like that superstition about eating katsudon the night before a big game?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! I like your thinking, but that's actually the opposite of what I had in mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The opposite?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! My goal today is to get you all more familiar with the country's most popular food items!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Becoming more comfortable with their culinary culture should make learning English a little easier, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Especially considering how much you and Akito have been struggling with your speaking lessons, An.

rows.Speaker: An & Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really did this just for us...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I did!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, but these may not taste quite the same as the real deal since I had to use what was available to me. I also tried not to make them too sweet...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, we'll get to compare the ones you made to the ones over there...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that could be something for us to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Please bring some over to SEKAI when you do! I'd also like to compare my work to the ones you find.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we'll need to start practicing the phrases we're going to use while shopping a lot more!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good point. Tipping workers is also a part of their culture, so we'll also need to learn how to pay people properly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The list of things we have to learn just keeps growing and growing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But learning these things will make our lives a lot easier when we're over there...
se_walk_women_004_1
se_walk_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here are your usual drinks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Where's mine, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your coffee?
Here you are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, Miku, if you're both free now, come join have some of these peanut butter and jelly sandwiches with us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
In the meantime, let's start eating!
Take a look. There's plenty of peanut butter and jelly on each one!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, “jelly” over there is what we call jam over here, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think so. By the way, what kind of jam is this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You'll have to take a bite to find out!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So, without further ado!
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line: Let's eat!
